# Is In Line of Sight

Source: [4657](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4657); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Is In Line of Sight](../../api/values/is-in-line-of-sight.md).

<a id="wiki-4657-n1"></a>

- When a player is supplied as LOS start or end, position is two meters above feet, not necessarily Eye Position.

<a id="wiki-4657-n2"></a>

- Enemy-barrier allegiance comes from the player supplied as start position, if any.
